source.title: Peregrine incident escalation
source.text: For a fictional Peregrine severity-one incident, page the duty lead immediately and open the response room.

target.title: Peregrine critical incident steps
target.text: Immediately alert the on-call lead and create the response room when fictional Peregrine has a severity-one incident.

source.title: Lemon tart filling
source.text: Whisk the fictional lemon custard over low heat until it coats a spoon, then cool it before filling.

target.title: Lemon tart pastry shell
target.text: Blind-bake the fictional tart shell with weights, remove them, and bake again until the pastry is golden.

source.title: Nimbus invoice approval
source.text: Fictional Nimbus invoices above 800 credits require approval from the finance lead.

target.title: Nimbus payment control
target.text: The finance lead must approve any fictional Nimbus invoice whose value exceeds 800 credits.

source.title: Silver orchid care
source.text: Water the fictional silver orchid when the top two centimeters of soil are dry and keep it out of direct sun.

target.title: Silver orchid growth log
target.text: The fictional silver orchid produced two new leaves in May after its pot was moved to the east window.

source.title: Current Vega upload limit
source.text: This decision replaces the earlier Vega limit: fictional uploads are now capped at 10 megabytes.

target.title: Earlier Vega upload limit
target.text: Fictional Vega uploads are capped at 20 megabytes.

source.title: Earlier Atlas pilot plan
source.text: The fictional Atlas pilot will begin in four regions.

target.title: Current Atlas pilot plan
target.text: This plan supersedes the four-region proposal; the fictional Atlas pilot will begin in two regions.

source.title: Quartz storage result
source.text: Every fictional Quartz export was encrypted at rest by default in the verified build.

target.title: Quartz storage limitation
target.text: Fictional Quartz exports are never encrypted at rest unless an operator enables encryption manually.

source.title: Mica support hours
source.text: The fictional Mica support desk is closed on Saturdays and Sundays.

target.title: Mica weekend coverage
target.text: The fictional Mica support desk is staffed every Saturday and Sunday.

source.title: Python retry helper
source.text: The fictional Python service retries a failed request twice before returning an error.

target.title: Python habitat card
target.text: The fictional python habitat card records humidity and basking temperature for a reptile enclosure.

source.title: Mercury release train
source.text: The fictional Mercury release train departs after the integration suite passes.

target.title: Mercury astronomy note
target.text: Mercury completes an orbit around the Sun faster than any other planet.

source.title: Decision follow-up
source.text: Use the second option next time because it solved the issue.

target.title: Options fragment
target.text: Two alternatives were reviewed, but their names and outcomes are not recorded in this note.

source.title: Cobalt threshold note
source.text: The fictional Cobalt threshold is 45, according to an undated draft.

target.title: Other Cobalt threshold note
target.text: The fictional Cobalt threshold is 60, according to another undated draft.
